arStrings.szText: Hate has poisoned this world, and only Akarat can save us from it.
Preaching to a crowd. Not fire and brimstone--he has a firm and gentle tone. Projected a bit to speak to a crowd of two dozen people.
Follow him to Skovos, and all will be transformed. He has promised a sign in the heavens that will herald this new age. An eclipse. Look to the skies!
